cycles.meaning: Familiar-regime reacquisition and retention, not new-task plasticity proof.

constraints: Trace reset controls reset only added E/F; every learned arm still has analytic readout gradient.
Diagonal sensitivity approximation drops cross-neuron derivative paths and is stale after updates.
Same optimizer-step budget, not equal computational work; old source passes reported separately.
Readout reservoir is pretrained, not random spiking LSM; supervised labels, no self-evaluator.

measurement_revision.reason: Unify frozen evaluation with main CPU measurements; adapter tests prove unchanged CUDA training semantics. An apparent long stall initially attributed to GPU contention was subsequently diagnosed as executor-session loss, not established GPU slowdown.
measurement_revision.selection: All 240 predeclared checkpoints and both conditions remeasured on CPU; retained CUDA prefix is auxiliary, never selected by scores.
measurement_revision.state_policy: Reuse immutable complete CUDA checkpoints and continue exact saved state; no h/world/Adam/E/F/RNG reset.
measurement_revision.preserved_cuda_data: data/credit/cycles-v1; read-only full prefix, source checkpoint references retained

cycles.interpretation: Familiar-regime reacquisition/retention. All primary frozen measurements use CPU; original CUDA v1 prefixes remain auxiliary. Main and cycle future cases and horizons differ, so they are not matched cases.
